messages:
Miranda (Design): Quick microcopy check — spotted an awkward inline error on the Routes table when save fails. Current CTA reads `Retry` and the helper text is `If this keeps happening contact support` (no punctuation). Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/route-save-error
Sam (PM): Good catch. I worry `Retry` reads like a system button, not an action on this row. Also missing punctuation looks sloppy.
Priya (Copy): My instinct: use sentence case and clearer phrasing. Proposed: "We couldn’t save your changes. Try again, or contact support." CTA: "Try again" (button) — or do we want `Save again`?
Alex (Eng): Implementation note: the row uses the global inline-action component. Changing the label is trivial. If we change to `Save again` we might need to tweak `aria-label` too — right now it's `Retry`.
Jordan (A11y): For screen readers context helps. If the button is generic `Try again`, add an aria-label like `Retry save` or `Retry saving route` depending on how specific we can be. Also ensure the helper text is reachable via `aria-describedby`.
Miranda (Design): I prefer `Try again` visually, plus `aria-label="Retry save"` on the button. Copy for the helper: `We couldn't save your changes. Try again, or contact support.` Period at the end.
Priya (Copy): Tiny nit: apostrophe in `couldn't` is fine. For the support link, prefer `contact support` as inline link to docs vs `reach out to support team` — shorter is better.
Sam (PM): Agree. UX question: should we provide a secondary action `Open logs`? That might be more than we need here.
Alex (Eng): Secondary action adds complexity — we can add a small `View details` that opens the console, but prefer to keep this patch to copy + aria-label, not new behaviors.
Jordan (A11y): Also: when the retry is in progress, aria-live should announce `Trying again…` and button text should change to `Trying again…` and have `aria-busy="true"`. Use ellipsis character `…` not three dots so screen readers read correctly.
Priya (Copy): So final microcopy bundle:
- Error helper: "We couldn't save your changes. Try again, or contact support."
- Primary CTA: "Try again" (button) with `aria-label="Retry save"`
- In-progress: "Trying again…" (aria-live polite)
Miranda (Design): I'll update the Figma component and add a small note about focus order. Priya — can you push these lines to the microcopy doc and add the alt text for the screenshot? :thumbsup:
Priya (Copy): On it — will add to /docs/microcopy/inline-errors.md and ping here when done.
Sam (PM): Thanks everyone. If no objections I’ll mark this as ready and pass to Eng for the small patch.
Alex (Eng): I'll pick this up tomorrow morning. Thanks for the clear copy + ARIA notes.
